_readme: Pictures the owner adds to this folder (git-ignored apart from this file; personal use only). enemies: map an enemy sprite key (kraan, giak, vordak) to an image; dark ink on a light or transparent ground works best, it is multiplied onto the parchment. hero: Lone Wolf on the maps, either a file already cut out, or {src, crop, outline} where crop [x, y, w, h] frames him standing on a plain ground, which is cut away at load, and outline (optional) is a polygon traced round him in crop pixels to keep the cut honest where he and the ground look alike. portrait: his likeness at the head of the Kai panel, {src, crop, fade}: crop [x, y, w, h] frames an ink drawing of him on light paper; the paper is keyed out and the edges fade into the page from fade (0-1) of the way out.
